text: Мученик Твој Господе, Мамант, у страдању своме је примио непропадљиви венац, од Тебе Бога нашега, јер имајући помоћ Твоју мучитеље победи, а разори и немоћну дрскост демона: Његовим молитвама спаси душе наше.
english: Thy martyr Mamas, O Lord, in his suffering received the incorruptible crown from thee, our God; for having thy help he vanquished the tormentors, and he shattered also the feeble insolence of the demons. By his prayers save our souls.

text: Θείον βλάστημα, Μαρτύρων πέλων, ηκολούθησας, ασχέτω πόθω, τοις ενθέοις αληθώς τούτων ίχνεσι και του Σωτήρος κηρύξας το όνομα, εθαυμαστώθης σοφέ δι' αθλήσεως. Μάμα ένδοξε, Χριστόν τον Θεόν ικέτευε, δωρήσασθαι ημίν το μέγα έλεος.
english: Being a divine shoot of the martyrs, thou didst follow with unrestrained longing their truly godly footsteps; and having preached the name of the Saviour, thou wast made wondrous through thy contest, O wise one. O glorious Mamas, entreat Christ God, that great mercy be granted unto us.

text: Τῆς Παφλαγόνου τὸ κλέος, καὶ Γαγγραίων τὸ στήριγμα, φύλαξ καὶ φρουρὸς τῶν Κυπρίων, ἀνεδείχθης, Μαμὰ ἔνδοξε. Τὴν Θάλασσαν διῆλθες ὥσπερ ζῶν, καὶ ταύτης τρικυμίας χαλινῶν, θαυμασίως λάρνακά σου, Μόρφου τὴ πάλει, Μάρτυς κατεστήριξας- διὸ ἐν τὴ μνήμη σου, σοφέ, εὐῶδες μύρον βρύει ἐξ αὐτῆς. Δόξα Θεῶ τῷ ἐνεργούντι, διὰ σοῦ πάσιν ἰάματα.
english: Thou wast shown forth as the glory of Paphlagonia and the stay of the people of Gangra, the guard and keeper of the Cypriots, O glorious Mamas. Thou didst pass over the sea as though thou wert living, and curbing its surging waves thou didst wondrously set thy reliquary fast in the city of Morphou, O martyr; wherefore at thy memorial, O wise one, sweet-smelling myrrh welleth forth from it. Glory to God, who works healings for all through thee.

text: Παφλαγονίας ὁ κλάδος καὶ μαρτύρων ἀγλάϊσμα, πόλεως Μόρφου τὸ κλέος καὶ Κυπρίων τὸ καύχημα, Λεόντων χάσματα ἔφραξας, Μάμα σοφέ, καὶ μαρτυρίου τὸν στέφανον κομισάμενος. Δόξα τῷ σὲ δοξάσαντι καὶ θαυμαστῶς ἐνισχύσαντι, δόξα τῷ χορηγοῦντι διὰ σοῦ πᾶσιν ἰάματα.
english: O branch of Paphlagonia and adornment of the martyrs, glory of the city of Morphou and boast of the Cypriots, thou didst stop the gaping jaws of the lions, O wise Mamas, and didst bear away the crown of martyrdom. Glory to him who glorified thee and wondrously gave thee strength; glory to him who bestows healings for all through thee.

text: Свет Трисиянный, всельшийся в душу твою,/ сосуд избран показа тя, всеблаженне,/ являюща Божественная концем,/ неудобопостижных разумений ты сказуяй, блаженне,/ и Троицу всем, Максиме, возпроповедуяй ясно,// Пресущную, Безначальную.
english: The thrice-radiant Light, having made its dwelling in thy soul, showed thee forth as a chosen vessel, O all-blessed one, making manifest things divine unto the ends of the earth; for thou didst set forth understandings hard to attain, O blessed one, and didst preach clearly unto all, O Maximus, the Trinity superessential and without beginning.

text: Lumina cea negrăită în inimi primindu-o, în munte v-aţi nevoit pentru dragostea Domnului și cununa răsplătirilor în ceruri ați primit. Iar noi laudă vă aducem, Sfinților Cuvioși Părinţi Neofit şi Meletie, strigând: Bucuraţi-vă, întărirea sihaştrilor şi slava creştinilor!
english: Having received in your hearts the light that cannot be uttered, ye struggled upon the mountain for the love of the Lord, and in the heavens ye received the crown of recompense. And we bring you praise, O holy venerable fathers Neophytos and Meletius, and cry aloud: Rejoice, strengthening of hermits and glory of Christians!

text: De Dumnezeu iubitorilor Părinţi, suindu-vă în munţii faptelor bune, locașuri Preasfântului Duh v-aţi arătat, iar acum ca făclia în sfeşnic luminaţi în lume, Cuvioşilor Neofit şi Meletie; rugaţi-vă lui Hristos-Dumnezeu să mântuiască sufletele noastre!
english: O fathers who loved God, ascending the mountains of the virtues ye were shown to be dwelling places of the Most Holy Spirit; and now, as a lamp upon its stand, ye give light unto the world, O venerable Neophytos and Meletius. Pray to Christ God that our souls may be saved.

text: Ἀλεξανδρείας φωστῆρα καί πατριάρχην σοφώτατον, γέννημα Ἁγίου Θωμᾶ τε τῆς κώμης ὄντως περίβλεπτον∙ τῆς Ἀγκαράθου τῆς Μονῆς τόν ἀστέρα καί Σιναίου Ὄρους Ἀπεζανῶν τε ἔνθεον ἀντιλήπτορα∙ Μελέτιον τόν θεῖον καί Ὀρθοδοξίας παμμέγιστον ἐν ἐνιαυτοῖς δυσχερέσι θεολόγον καί ὑπέρμαχον∙ πάντες οἱ ἐν Κρήτῃ αὐτοῦ μαθηταί συνελθόντες πόθῳ ὑμνήσωμεν∙ αὐτός γάρ τήν Τριάδα ἡμῖν ἵλεων ἀπεργάζεται.
english: The luminary of Alexandria and most wise patriarch, the truly renowned offspring of the village of Hagios Thomas, the star of the Monastery of Angarathos and the God-inspired protector of the Mount of Sinai and of Apezanoi, the divine Meletios, in years of hardship the greatest theologian and champion of Orthodoxy: let us all, his disciples in Crete, come together and hymn him with longing; for he himself maketh the Trinity merciful unto us.

text: Ὡς ἔνσαρκος Ἄγγελος, καὶ ὑπηρέτης Χριστοῦ, ὡς ἔνθεος ἄνθρωπος καὶ ἀσκητῶν καλλονή, Μελέτιε Ὅσιε, χάριτας θεοδότους, ἐκομίσω διώκειν, πνεύματα πονηρίας, καὶ νοσοῦντας ἰᾶσθαι, δι’ ὅ καὶ ἡ σεπτή σου σορὸς βρύει ἰάματα.
english: As an angel in the flesh and a servant of Christ, as a man filled with God and the beauty of ascetics, O venerable Meletios, thou didst receive God-given graces to drive out the spirits of wickedness and to heal the sick; wherefore thy honoured reliquary also poureth forth healings.

text: Ἐξ ἐῴας ἔνδοξε, πρὸς τὴν ἑσπέραν φοιτήσας, ὥσπερ ἄλλος ἥλιος, τῶν ἀρετῶν τὰς ἀκτῖνας, ἥπλωσας, καὶ συνηγάγω πρὸς τὴν σὴν θάλψιν, ἅπαντας, τοὺς ἐν ψύχει παθῶν χειμαζομένους, ὅθεν νῦν σε συνελθόντες, ἀνευφημοῦμεν, Μελέτιε Ὅσιε.
english: O glorious one, coming from the East unto the West, thou didst spread abroad the rays of the virtues like another sun, and didst gather unto thy warmth all those tempest-tossed in the cold of the passions; wherefore now we come together and praise thee, O venerable Meletios.

text: Τᾶς τρεῖς ἔνδοξους Παρθένους καὶ Ἀθληφόρους θεόφρονας, τᾶς συνδεδεμένος ἐνθέως, ἀδελφικὴ οἰκειότητι, τᾶς καλλιρόους πηγᾶς τῆς εὐσέβειας, τᾶς ἀναβλύζουσας, μαρτυρικῶν ἀγώνων χάριν ἀέναον, τὴν θείαν Μηνοδώραν, καὶ τὴν Μητροδώραν τὴν ἔνδοξον, σὺν τὴ κλυτὴ Νυμφοδώρα, τὴ ἐν πάσι καρτερόφρονι, πάντες οἱ τρυφῶντες τῶν ἄθλων αὐτῶν, συνδραμόντες ὕμνοις τιμήσωμεν αὑταὶ γὰρ τὴ Τριάδι, ὑπὲρ ἠμῶν ἀεὶ πρεσβεύουσι.
english: The three glorious virgins and prize-winning contestants of godly mind, bound together in godly wise by sisterly kinship, the fair-flowing fountains of piety, which pour forth the ever-flowing grace of the martyrs' contests, the divine Menodora and the glorious Metrodora with the renowned Nymphodora, steadfast of mind in all things: let us all who take delight in their contests run together and honour them with hymns; for they ever intercede with the Trinity on our behalf.

text: Τὸν τρισάριθμον σύλλογον καὶ θεόπλοκον τῶν αὐτάδελφων παρθένων στέψωμεν θείαις ᾠδαῖς· ἀνδρικῶς γὰρ τὸν ἐχθρὸν κατετροπώσαντο· ὅθεν προϊστάντι ἡμῶν τῶν βοώντων ἐκτενῶς· χαῖρε, σεμνὴ Μηνοδώρα, σὺν Μητροδώρα τῇ θείᾳ καὶ Νυμφοδώρα τῇ θεόφρονι.
english: Let us crown with divine odes the threefold and God-woven company of the sisters who were virgins; for manfully did they put the enemy to rout. Wherefore they stand as protectors of us who cry fervently: Rejoice, O chaste Menodora, with the divine Metrodora and the God-minded Nymphodora.

text: Valurile cele întreite ale chinurilor şi moarte amară, pentru viaţa cea veşnică aţi schimbat, sfintelor muceniţe trei fecioare, mărturisind înaintea divanurilor celor fărădelege pe Treimea Cea Nezidită. Pentru aceea, cu sabia fiind tăiate, urmaţi acum Mielului Celui înjunghiat şi vă rugaţi pentru cei ce cinstesc sfinţită pomenirea voastră.
english: The threefold waves of torments and a bitter death did ye exchange for life everlasting, O holy martyrs, ye three virgins, confessing before the lawless tribunals the Uncreated Trinity. Wherefore, having been cut down by the sword, ye now follow the Lamb that was slain, and ye pray for those who honour your sacred memory.

text: Правило веры и образ кротости / словом и житием пастве твоей, отче смиренномудре Митрофане, был еси. / Темже и во светлостех святых / солнца светлейше возсиял еси, / венцем нетления и славы украшаемь, / моли Христа Бога / стране нашей и граду твоему в мире спастися.
english: A rule of faith and an image of meekness wast thou to thy flock, in word and in life, O father Mitrophan of humble wisdom. Wherefore in the splendours of the saints thou hast shone forth brighter than the sun, adorned with the crown of incorruption and of glory. Pray to Christ God that our land and thy city may be saved in peace.

text: Воздержанием тело духу поработив,/ душу же равноангельну сотворив,/ святительскою одеялся еси одеждею, яко венец священства,/ и ныне, всех Владыце предстоя,/ моли, всеблаженне Митрофане, умирити и спасти души наша.
english: Having brought thy body into subjection to the spirit by abstinence, and having made thy soul the equal of the angels, thou wast clothed in the vesture of a hierarch as in a crown of priesthood; and now, standing before the Master of all, pray, O all-blessed Mitrophan, that our souls may be given peace and be saved.

text: Τῶν παθῶν καταλείψας Πάτερ τὴν Αἴγυπτον, τῶν ἀρετῶν ἐν τῷ ὄρει ἀνῆλθες πίστει θερμή, τὸν Σταυρὸν τὸν τοῦ Χριστοῦ ἄρας ἐπ' ὤμων σου, καὶ δοξασθεῖς περιφανῶς τύπος ὤφθης Μοναστῶν, Μωσῆ Πατέρων ἀκρότης, μεθ' ὧν ἀπαύστως δυσώπει ἐλεηθήναι τᾶς ψυχᾶς ἠμῶν.
english: Having forsaken the Egypt of the passions, O father, thou didst ascend with fervent faith the mountain of the virtues, taking up upon thy shoulders the Cross of Christ; and being glorified in the sight of all, thou wast shown forth as a pattern for monastics, O Moses, summit of the fathers. Together with them entreat thou unceasingly that our souls may find mercy.

text: На высоту добродетелей возшел еси пророче Моисее:/ и сего ради сподобился еси видети славу Божию,/ скрижали благодатныя закона прият/ и начертаний благодать в себе нося,/ и пророков был еси честная похвала,/ и благочестия великое таинство.
english: Thou didst ascend unto the height of the virtues, O prophet Moses, and therefore wast thou counted worthy to behold the glory of God. Thou didst receive the grace-bearing tablets of the law, and bearing within thyself the grace of what was written thereon, thou wast the honoured praise of the prophets and the great mystery of piety.

text: A prorocului Tău, Moise, pomenire, Doamne, prăznuind, printr-însul Te rugăm, mântuieşte sufletele noastre.
english: Keeping the memory of thy prophet Moses, O Lord, through him we entreat thee: save our souls.

text: Suindu-te către înălţimea bunătăţilor, Sfinte Prorocule Moise, te-ai învrednicit a vedea Strălucirea lui Dumnezeu, primind tablele cele date de Dumnezeu; şi purtând întru tine darul însemnărilor, te-ai făcut cinstită laudă prorocilor şi mare taină a dreptei credinţe.
english: Ascending unto the height of good things, O holy prophet Moses, thou wast counted worthy to behold the Radiance of God, receiving the tablets given of God; and bearing within thee the gift of what was written thereon, thou wast made the honoured praise of the prophets and the great mystery of the right faith.

text: Γνόφον ἄυλον, τεθεαμένος, νόμον ἔνθεον, πλαξὶν ἐδέξω, ὡς θεάμων μυστηρίων τοῦ Πνεύματος καὶ καταπλήξας τὴν Αἴγυπτον θαύμασι, δημαγωγὸς Ἰσραὴλ ἐχρημάτισας. Μωυσῆ ἔνδοξε, Χριστὸν τὸν Θεὸν ἱκέτευε, δωρήσασθαι ἠμιν τὸ μέγα ἔλεος.
english: Having gazed upon the immaterial darkness, thou didst receive the law divine upon tablets of stone, as a beholder of the mysteries of the Spirit; and having astounded Egypt with wonders, thou wast appointed the leader of the people of Israel. O glorious Moses, entreat Christ God, that great mercy be granted unto us.

text: Измлада Христа возлюбив, преславне,/ и Того соблюдая Божественныя заповеди,/ к Тому притекл еси весь цел,/ Мироне всечестне,/ и со Ангелы молишися прилежно./ Проси всем почитающим память твою// оставления грехов.
english: Having loved Christ from thy youth, O most glorious one, and keeping his divine commandments, thou didst hasten unto him whole and undivided, O all-honourable Myron, and with the angels thou prayest diligently. Ask remission of sins for all who honour thy memory.

text: Мученик Твој Господе, Мирон, у страдању своме је примио непропадљиви венац, од Тебе Бога нашега, јер имајући помоћ Твоју мучитеље победи, а разори и немоћну дрскост демона: Његовим молитвама спаси душе наше.
english: Thy martyr Myron, O Lord, in his suffering received the incorruptible crown from thee, our God; for having thy help he vanquished the tormentors, and he shattered also the feeble insolence of the demons. By his prayers save our souls.

text: Νίκην ἔστησας, κατὰ τῆς πλάνης, νίκης εἴληφας, ἄφθαρτον γέρας, ἐπαξίως Νικήτα φερώνυμε, σὺ γὰρ νικήσας ἐχθρῶν τὴν παράταξιν, διὰ πυρὸς τὸν ἀγῶνα ἐτέλεσας. Μάρτυς ἔνδοξε, Χριστὸν τὸν Θεὸν ἱκέτευε, δωρήσασθαι ἠμὶν τὸ μέγα ἔλεος.
english: Thou didst set up a victory against error, and hast worthily received the incorruptible prize of victory, O Nicetas, who bearest a fitting name; for having conquered the battle array of the enemies, thou didst accomplish thy contest through fire. O glorious martyr, entreat Christ God, that great mercy be granted unto us.

text: Purtătorule de chinuri, biruind mai întâi năvălirile barbarilor cu Puterea Crucii cea nebiruită, pe urmă ai surpat mândria demonilor, împotrivindu-te cu vitejia ta, înţelepte; şi biruind-o, Sfinte Mucenice Nichita, ai luat daruri vrednice de biruinţă. Slavă lui Hristos, Cel Ce te-a întărit; Slavă Celui Ce te-a încununat; Slavă Celui Ce a mărit pururea cinstită pomenirea ta.
english: O passion-bearer, having first overcome the onslaughts of the barbarians by the unconquerable power of the Cross, thereafter thou didst cast down the pride of the demons, withstanding it by thy valour, O wise one; and having overcome it, O holy martyr Nicetas, thou didst receive gifts worthy of the victory. Glory to Christ who gave thee strength; glory to him who crowned thee; glory to him who hath magnified thy ever-honoured memory.

text: De tulburările lumești depărtându-te, casa și patria ai părăsit și pe pământul Moldovei ai trăit viață sihăstrească. Asemenea marilor cuvioși, ai ajutat pe mulți cu rugăciunile și povețele tale, Cuvioase Părinte Onufrie.
english: Departing from the tumults of the world, thou didst forsake house and homeland, and in the land of Moldavia thou didst live the life of a hermit. Like unto the great venerable ones, thou didst help many by thy prayers and thy counsels, O venerable father Onuphrius.
